stories.title: Bandstand square planned for Buckley car park as town centre survey closes Sunday
stories.summary: Plans for a new square with a bandstand on part of Brunswick Road car park are among the Buckley town centre designs people have until Sunday 22 November to comment on. stories.title: Government drops planned Connah’s Quay power station from HyNet carbon capture talks
stories.summary: The UK Government has dropped plans for a new carbon capture power station at Connah’s Quay from its talks on HyNet. stories.title: Hughes Pharmacy moves to bigger shop in Mold’s Daniel Owen Shopping Centre
stories.summary: Hughes Pharmacy at Daniel Owen Shopping Centre in Mold is moving into a bigger shop in the centre on Monday 23 November. stories.title: Connah’s Quay wrestler Drew Parker to appear at Deeside Leisure Centre
stories.summary: The former Big Japan Pro Wrestling star has joined the National Wrestling League, which holds its first Welsh show in Queensferry on Friday 27 November.

stories.title: Andy Burnham says no to Wales taking control of policing, rail infrastructure and The Crown Estate
stories.summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham has said no to Wales taking control of its own policing, railway infrastructure and The Crown Estate.
